properties.site-address: Remaining Picc Basin Sites (Plots A, B, D, E, F, G, J, K, L)
properties.notes: To be developed in line with the Piccadilly Basin Strategic Regeneration Framework http://www.manchester.gov.uk/downloads/download/6491/piccadilly_basin_srf_october_2016_final. Approx 'MinNetDwellings' expected however proposals for a higher number of dwellings will be considered. No maximum has been set but all proposals must be in line with the Council's design quality requirements and any relevant Council-endorsed planning framework or masterplan
